mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders

SELECT p.name, p.unit, i.current_stock, i.warn_threshold, (i.warn_threshold - i.current_stock) AS gap FROM inventory i JOIN product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.current_stock <= i.warn_threshold ORDER BY gap DESC

SELECT p.name, p.unit, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS amount FROM order_item oi JOIN product p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.unit ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS amount FROM order_item oi JOIN product p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT m.member_id, m.name, m.phone, m.points_balance, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM member m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name, m.phone, m.points_balance HAVING order_count > 0 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT pay_method, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY amount DESC
